programs.title: Great White Shark Babies
programs.desc: Dr. Mauricio Hoyos teams up with Michelle Jewell and Toby Daly-Engel in search of where the pregnant females of Guadalupe have their pups. Mauricio believes they go to the coast of Baja, but what they find while they're there is a Shark Week first.

programs.title: Treetop Cat Rescue: Out on a Limb
programs.desc: Tom must navigate a sloping tree to rescue a difficult cat  Shaun faces wet and damp conditions to save a friendly, homesick stray.

programs.title: The Zoo: The Elephant Next Door
programs.desc: The zoo staff works to build a relationship between a pair of Asian elephants with very different personalities  vets treat an ocellated turkey chick's foot condition  Isabella the North American beaver undergoes a tooth trim.

programs.title: Dogs: The Untold Story: Wild Survivors
programs.desc: Traveling the globe to explore the characteristics that make a wild dog wild, discover how their past has shaped your pet and learn the differences between your dog at home and its wild relatives.

programs.title: Crikey! It's the Irwins: Robert & the Rattlesnakes
programs.desc: Robert wrangles western diamondback rattlesnakes in Arizona for the first time, learning techniques passed down by his dad  Terri helps save some of the hospital's tiniest patients, three baby feathertail gliders  Bindi chats with Occa the cockatoo.
